race.comment: KOOKY (5) made a winning start in Tasmania when she led and went on to score at this circuit and distance first up, arriving 3.5 metres ahead of her rivals. Similar draw and should strip fitter so can strike again. ELEANOR STREET (1) was runner-up on debut at Young two runs ago before breaking when well fancied at her latest appearance here. Has trialled well since and the inside draw should ensure a cosy run. Big chance with manners. DANGER BEWARE (10) cops a tricky draw but looks to have ability having debuted with a win at this circuit and distance. With luck she could go on with it. RAZZMATAZZ (6) won on debut then broke when second to KOOKY last start. Can feature if she gets it right.
